clue.text: Face sanction

definitions.meaning: the face or expression, as in keeping a straight face
as a verb, to approve or tolerate something

explanation.surface: A demand that someone face up to a penalty.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a person's facial expression and, as a verb, to permit or allow.

clue.text: Old dealer finally cut deck

indicators.note: finally picks out only the closing letter of the word dealer

parts.note: to lop is to cut off

explanation.surface: An old card dealer at last cuts the deck.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the lowest deck of a sailing ship, the nautical sense of deck rather than cards.

clue.text: Unspoilt old city in south African region

indicators.note: in tells us the old city sits within the name of the region

parts.note: Natal is a former province of South Africa, now KwaZulu-Natal
Ur is the ancient Mesopotamian city, a crossword favourite

explanation.surface: An ancient city found untouched in a region of southern Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unspoilt is in its original, unaltered state, as nature made it.

clue.text: Demands and gets old bills

parts.note: ex- means former, as in ex-wife
a bill passed by Parliament becomes an act, so former bills are acts

explanation.surface: Someone insists on and collects payment of long-overdue bills.
explanation.walkthrough: 'old bills' reads as unpaid invoices, but cryptically a parliamentary bill, once passed, is an Act.
explanation.definitionFit: To exact payment is to demand and obtain it, often forcefully.

clue.text: It's arena is shaped like a sort of well

indicators.note: is shaped tells us the letters of the preceding words are formed into a new pattern

parts.note: the contraction gives the letters I, T, S

explanation.surface: An arena whose outline resembles a kind of well.
explanation.definitionFit: An artesian well is one bored into rock where water rises under its own pressure.

clue.text: Having nothing to wear in pet show

indicators.note: in places the nudity inside the household pet

parts.note: a cat is a typical household pet
bare means naked, wearing nothing

explanation.surface: Someone has nothing suitable to wear for a pet show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pet show' looks like one phrase, but 'pet' is part of the wordplay and 'show' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A cabaret is a nightclub entertainment, a kind of stage show.

clue.text: A little luck is worth loads

parts.note: little means small
fortune means luck or chance

explanation.surface: A bit of luck can be worth a great deal.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase is ironic: a 'small' fortune actually means a large sum of money.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiom for a great deal of money, which is what loads means informally.

clue.text: Church with an ordinary minister

parts.note: an gives the indefinite article A
plain means ordinary or unremarkable

explanation.surface: A church served by an ordinary clergyman.
explanation.definitionFit: A chaplain is a clergyman attached to an institution such as a school, hospital or regiment.

clue.text: Get a lift after receiving a bullet wound

definitions.text: Get a lift after receiving a bullet wound

parts.words: Get a lift after receiving a bullet wound
parts.note: a gunshot to the upper limb is literally described, while the phrase is an idiom for a boost of encouragement

explanation.surface: Someone is cheered up after being shot.
explanation.walkthrough: The literal reading, a bullet lodged in a limb, hides the figurative idiom for a stimulus or boost.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means a revitalising boost, like an injection of energy that lifts spirits.

clue.text: Leave a narrow opening across top of pipe

indicators.note: across means the narrow opening is spread around the other letter

parts.note: a slit is a narrow opening or cut

indicators.note: top of takes just the initial letter of the word pipe

explanation.surface: Instructions to cut a narrow gap across the top of a pipe.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally to split is to leave or depart quickly.

clue.text: Travelling south, a ban on roads like this

indicators.note: travelling suggests letters on the move, rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A ban on heading south along certain roads.
explanation.definitionFit: An autobahn is a German motorway, the kind of road the clue describes.

clue.text: A head of state confronts hijackers with such letters

indicators.note: confronts means stands in front of, so the letter comes before the hijackers
head of picks the first letter of the word state

parts.note: pirates are hijackers of ships

explanation.surface: A head of state faces down a gang of hijackers.
explanation.definitionFit: These are breathed sounds such as H, consonants pronounced with a puff of breath.

clue.text: Traditionally styled material with rococo borders

parts.note: rep is a ribbed fabric used in upholstery

indicators.note: borders picks the first and last letters of the word rococo

explanation.surface: Old-fashioned fabric trimmed with ornate rococo edging.
explanation.definitionFit: Short for reproduction, it describes furniture made to imitate an older style.

clue.text: Place for less fattening source of energy?

parts.note: lo-cal is short for low-calorie

indicators.note: source of takes the first letter of the word energy

explanation.surface: Where to find a low-calorie source of energy?
explanation.definitionFit: A locale is a setting or location where something happens.

clue.text: Tiger needs a groom in this chamber!

parts.note: a tiger is a big cat
to comb hair is to groom it

explanation.surface: A tiger requires grooming in this room!
explanation.definitionFit: A catacomb is an underground burial chamber or tunnel.

clue.text: Beef cooked thus imparts a fresh look

indicators.note: a fresh look suggests the letters are presented in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Cooking beef in a certain way gives it a fresh appearance.
explanation.definitionFit: Pastrami is seasoned, smoked beef, so the dish names a way beef is prepared.

clue.text: Plights following gamble on short changing

indicators.note: on means the gamble is placed next to the rearranged letters that follow

parts.note: a bet is a gamble

indicators.note: changing tells us the word short is rearranged

explanation.surface: Trouble follows a bet placed on short-changing someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short changing' looks like the cheating phrase; here 'changing' scrambles SHORT into ROTHS.
explanation.definitionFit: To plight one's troth is to promise marriage, so plights means promises in wedlock.

clue.text: Unfashionable peer of the realm is heard, but banned

parts.note: out means no longer in fashion

indicators.note: is heard tells us the peer's title is spoken, giving a word of the same sound

parts.note: a lord is a peer of the realm

explanation.surface: A peer who is out of favour is heard but then barred.
explanation.walkthrough: In British non-rhotic speech LORD and LAWED sound alike.
explanation.definitionFit: To be made an outlaw is to be prohibited, put outside the law.

clue.text: Aerial worker gives girl a lift

parts.note: the worker ant is a crossword staple

indicators.note: in a down clue a lift raises the name, reading it from bottom to top

parts.note: Anne is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A worker on an aerial gives a girl a ride.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Aerial' looks like an adjective about height, but it is the noun.
explanation.definitionFit: An antenna is a radio or TV aerial for receiving signals.

clue.text: Cereal regularly left for ice-cream holder

parts.note: corn is a cereal crop

indicators.note: regularly picks every other letter of the word left

explanation.surface: Cereal is regularly left out for someone holding an ice cream.
explanation.definitionFit: A cornet is a wafer cone for ice cream, as British usage calls it.

clue.text: Player getting open top vehicle home before action starts

indicators.note: before places the home letters ahead of the next piece
top picks the first letter of the word open

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
in means at home

indicators.note: starts picks the first letter of the word action

explanation.surface: A musician arrives home in an open-topped car before the show begins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'open top vehicle' suggests a convertible; instead 'top' takes only the O of 'open'.
explanation.definitionFit: An ocarina is a small egg-shaped wind instrument, something one plays.

clue.text: This Japanese finds his age is variable

indicators.note: is variable tells us the letters can be changed into another order

explanation.surface: A Japanese woman discovers that his age varies.
explanation.definitionFit: A geisha is a Japanese hostess trained in traditional arts and entertainment.

clue.text: Implied diplomacy protects one

indicators.note: protects means the diplomacy surrounds and shields the other letter

parts.note: tact is diplomacy
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Unspoken diplomacy that safeguards an individual.
explanation.definitionFit: Tacit means understood without being stated, so implied.

clue.text: Engineers, once in front of a bomb, have another look

indicators.note: in front of places the earlier pieces ahead of the bomb

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps
ex means former, once
a mine is an explosive device

explanation.surface: Engineers, once facing a bomb, take a second look.
explanation.definitionFit: To examine again is simply to look over something a second time.

clue.text: Expression used by little girl in island

indicators.note: in puts the girl's name inside the island's abbreviation

parts.note: IOM is the Isle of Man
Di is a short form of Diana

explanation.surface: An expression used by a young girl on an island.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom is a fixed figurative phrase or turn of speech.

clue.text: Proposes to put names into ballot

indicators.note: a ballot draws names at random, so the letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: Candidates are put forward by placing names in a ballot.
explanation.definitionFit: To nominate is to put someone forward as a candidate.

clue.text: One that's in credit could be colder

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation for that is inside the credit letters

parts.note: CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit
i.e. stands for id est, that is

explanation.surface: Someone who is in credit might be colder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One that's in credit' reads as a solvent person, but 'that's' gives IE.
explanation.definitionFit: Icier is the comparative of icy, meaning more frozen or chilly.

clue.text: They cause panic, making all safe with weapons

indicators.note: making suggests the letters are formed into something new

parts.note: arms are weapons

explanation.surface: Panic caused by trying to secure everything with guns.
explanation.definitionFit: False alarms are warnings that turn out baseless but cause needless fear.
